description:
Fully tear down a staging instance: the box teardown (its unit/conf/nginx/db/
    data_dir - via the same isolation-guarded path as instance_remove) PLUS the
    Cloudflare cleanup instance_remove leaves behind - retract the staging subdomain's
    DNS A record and delete its Access app. Pass `zone` to do the CF cleanup; omit it to
    only tear down the box and get a reminder. PREFERRED credential path: save the token
    to a file (chmod 600) and pass token_file=<path> - the path is safe in chat, the
    secret is not. (Also: ZX_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE / ZX_CF_TOKEN_FILE env paths, or the
    raw ZX_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN / ZX_CF_TOKEN.) The Access app lives in YOUR account - pass
    account_id=… (or ZX_CF_ACCOUNT_ID). `db_name` must end with '_staging' (guards
    against pointing this at a production db). dry_run shows the plan; confirm executes.
name: staging_remove
